spec.doc: Registers `agent` as the first agent with every role and the global caps as its own. `max_net_exposure` caps capital deployed in open positions across all markets at once (see `net_exposure`); it must be at least `max_trade`. `config_delay` (seconds, at least `MIN_CONFIG_DELAY`) is the timelock on every loosening change. Any collateral the treasury already holds is minted as shares to `admin`.
spec.name: __constructor

spec.doc: Buys `outcome` shares in an existing market using treasury capital (`ROLE_TRADE`). Price-checked, see `do_agent_buy`.
spec.name: agent_buy

spec.doc: `agent_buy` with a per-share limit price (`limit_price_bps`, 0 = none) and a deadline (unix seconds, network time). market-core's `buy_v2` enforces both; an expired or out-of-limit trade reverts the whole invocation, so the treasury's caps are never consumed by a reverted trade.
spec.name: agent_buy_v2

spec.doc: Claims the market's LP fee share for a market the treasury created (`ROLE_SETTLE`). The LP portion accrues separately on market-core (see its `claim_lp_fees`).
spec.name: agent_claim_lp_fees

spec.doc: Agents ever registered (removed ones included).
spec.name: agent_count

spec.doc: Creates and seeds a market using treasury capital (`ROLE_CREATE`). The treasury becomes the market's creator/LP. `initial_yes_bps` must lie within the price policy's `[min_sell, max_buy]` band, so the treasury never seeds a market whose creator side is near worthless.
spec.name: agent_create_market

spec.doc: Like [`Treasury::agent_create_market`], but reveals the resolution rule in the same transaction (#64). The market is created with the commitment derived from `spec_v2` itself, so the follow-up reveal necessarily matches and the market can never be left unresolvable. `resolver` is the deployed resolver contract; it must be configured for this treasury's market-core. The router cannot serve this path: seeding pulls collateral from the treasury contract (not the end user) via a contract self-authorization, which only this contract can perform — a stateless router between the agent and market-core would not be authorized on the token.
spec.name: agent_create_market_and_reveal

spec.doc: `agent`'s own sliding-window usage, counted against its `max_daily`.
spec.name: agent_daily_usage

spec.doc: Sells `outcome` shares back into the pool for exactly `collateral_out` (`ROLE_TRADE`). This returns capital to the treasury (market-core pays out of its own balance), so it is not capped and does not need the nested-transfer pre-authorization that buying does. It frees net headroom (`collateral_out` is recorded) but never lifetime headroom. Price-checked, see `do_agent_sell`.
spec.name: agent_sell

spec.doc: `agent_sell` with a per-share limit price (`limit_price_bps`, 0 = no limit) and a deadline (unix seconds, network time), both enforced by market-core's `sell_v2`.
spec.name: agent_sell_v2

spec.doc: Total capital deployable: liquid collateral balance plus supplied yield value.
spec.name: available_capital

spec.doc: Breakdown of treasury capital across liquid, yield principal, and yield value.
spec.name: capital_breakdown

spec.doc: Claims the LP pool remainder for a market the treasury created (`ROLE_SETTLE`).
spec.name: claim_pool_remainder

spec.doc: Pays the ticket at the head of the queue as far as idle collateral allows. Permissionless: the money always goes to the ticket's owner. Only the head ticket can be paid (`NothingToPay` for later ones).
spec.name: claim_withdraw

spec.doc: Marks a market's exposure as exited (`ROLE_SETTLE`). Pure bookkeeping (see `MarketExposure`) for the future exposure dashboard; it does not move funds or free either the cumulative per-market cap or net headroom.
spec.name: close_trade

spec.doc: Pulls accrued **protocol** fees from a configured market-core contract. Only the protocol's share of each market's fees: the LP portion accrues separately on market-core and belongs to the market's creator — for agent-created markets that is the treasury itself, via `agent_claim_lp_fees`. Fees raise NAV for every shareholder at the moment they arrive.
spec.name: collect_market_fees

spec.doc: How much more the agents together may deploy right now before `max_daily` (`max_daily - window sum`, floored at 0).
spec.name: daily_headroom

spec.doc: Usage over the sliding window as of now: `amount` sums every bucket still counted against `max_daily`, `day_start` is the start of the oldest of them. Side-effect free (it advances a copy), so repeated reads without trades in between return the same value.
spec.name: daily_usage

spec.doc: The hourly buckets behind `daily_usage`, advanced to now (not stored).
spec.name: daily_usage_detail

spec.doc: Deposits `amount` of collateral and mints shares to `from` at the NAV as it was before the deposit. Returns the shares minted.
spec.name: deposit

spec.doc: While paused only: burns `shares` for their pro-rata part of the free idle collateral, without reading market-core (for when it is the thing that broke). The owner forfeits their part of open positions, which stays with the remaining shareholders.
spec.name: emergency_withdraw

spec.doc: Applies `agent`'s pending policy once its delay has passed. Permissionless: the delay is the protection.
spec.name: execute_agent

spec.doc: Applies the pending config once its delay has passed. Permissionless, so execution never depends on the admin being available. A `market_core` change records the old core as legacy: its positions stay where they are (recover them with `legacy_redeem` / `legacy_claim_pool_remainder`), and exposure for the new core is kept under keys namespaced by core so market ids cannot collide. The new core must be pointed at this treasury with its own `set_treasury`.
spec.name: execute_config

spec.doc: Applies the pending price policy once its delay has passed. Permissionless.
spec.name: execute_price_policy

spec.doc: Deprecated compatibility view in the pre-registry `RiskConfig` shape: `agent` is the first registered agent (whatever its current policy). Use `get_global` and `get_agent` instead.
spec.name: get_config

spec.doc: `max_net_exposure`.
spec.name: get_net_cap

spec.doc: `claim_pool_remainder` against a legacy market-core.
spec.name: legacy_claim_pool_remainder

spec.doc: `redeem` against a market-core this treasury was switched away from (see `execute_config`), so positions there are never stranded.
spec.name: legacy_redeem

spec.doc: Liquid collateral balance held directly in the treasury.
spec.name: liquid_capital

spec.doc: Conservative valuation of the treasury's holdings in `market_id` (see [`Valuation`]). Two cross-contract reads (`get_market`, `get_position`); a view only, never on the trading path.
spec.name: market_valuation

spec.doc: Moves the treasury's position in `market_id` — and the LP role, when the treasury is the market's creator and has not claimed the remainder yet — to the successor set via `set_successor`, then closes the local exposure. Admin-only: relocating capital is not an agent trading action, and the agent key must not be able to drain positions. market-core's `transfer_position` / `transfer_lp` require the treasury itself to authorize. Because the treasury is their *direct* caller here, the implicit invoker authorization covers both — no `authorize_as_current_contract` entry is needed (unlike the nested token transfer in `agent_buy`, see `docs/adr/0002-treasury-nested-auth.md`).
spec.name: migrate_market

spec.doc: Net asset value: idle collateral plus, for every market in the open- market index, what the holdings are worth whatever the outcome (complete sets and the LP's `min` reserve while open, the exact settlement value once final), minus what queued withdrawals are owed. Directional exposure is valued at zero, so no trade against a pool can raise NAV.
spec.name: nav

spec.doc: Capital currently deployed across all markets: `sum(max(0, collateral_in - collateral_out))`, the figure `max_net_exposure` is enforced against.
spec.name: net_exposure

spec.doc: Net position in `market_id` of the current market-core.
spec.name: net_position

spec.doc: Proposes `config` as the global config (admin). Tighten-only proposals apply at once and leave any pending proposal and its timer as they are; anything else is queued.
spec.name: propose_config

spec.doc: The ticket `claim_withdraw` pays next, and the id the next one gets.
spec.name: queue_bounds

spec.doc: Collateral owed to queued withdrawals; agents cannot spend it.
spec.name: queue_reserved

spec.doc: Redeems the treasury's position in a resolved/voided market (`ROLE_SETTLE`).
spec.name: redeem

spec.doc: Deactivates `agent` at once, keeping its usage history. At least one active agent with `ROLE_SETTLE` must remain, so open positions can always be settled.
spec.name: remove_agent

spec.doc: Burns `shares` of `owner` at the current NAV, pays what free idle collateral allows now and queues the rest as a ticket (FIFO, paid by `claim_withdraw` as capital returns). Returns `(paid_now, ticket_id)`, `ticket_id` 0 when nothing was queued.
spec.name: request_withdraw

spec.doc: Adds or updates `agent`. Validation: `roles` non-empty and known, `0 < max_trade <= max_daily`, both within the global caps, `active`.
spec.name: set_agent

spec.doc: Lengthens the timelock. Shortening is refused outright: it would itself have to wait out the old delay to be safe, and a lengthening can always be undone by redeploying.
spec.name: set_config_delay

spec.doc: Sets the price limits on agent trades (admin). Like the caps, tightening (lower `max_buy`/`max_impact`/`max_slippage`, higher `min_sell`) applies at once and anything else waits `config_delay`.
spec.name: set_price_policy

spec.doc: Sets the successor treasury that `migrate_market` hands positions and the LP role to. Admin-only; overwrites any previous successor (the `SuccessorSet` events are the audit trail).
spec.name: set_successor

spec.doc: Permissionless settlement of a resolved or voided market's position and LP remainder. Operates even when the treasury is paused. Idempotent on retry.
spec.name: settle_market

spec.doc: One registered agent. `max_trade` / `max_daily` sit under the global caps; both are checked on every spend.
spec.name: AgentPolicy

spec.doc: Summary of the sliding daily window, returned by `daily_usage`. `day_start` is the start of the oldest hour still counted and `amount` the usage summed over the whole window (see [`UsageWindow`]).
spec.name: DailyUsage

spec.doc: Treasury-wide caps, enforced on top of every agent's own policy.

fields.doc: Cap on capital deployed in open positions across all markets at once (see `net_exposure`).
fields.name: max_net_exposure

spec.name: GlobalConfig

spec.doc: Collateral the treasury has sent into (`collateral_in`) and received back from (`collateral_out`) one market. Accounting starts when this code was deployed: a missing entry reads as zero.
spec.name: NetPosition

spec.doc: An entry of the open-market index `nav()` walks.
spec.name: OpenMarket

spec.doc: Price limits on every agent trade, in bps of the outcome's spot price.

fields.doc: Never buy an outcome priced above this.
fields.name: max_buy_price_bps

fields.doc: Largest `|p_after - p_before|` a single trade may cause.
fields.name: max_impact_bps

fields.doc: Tolerance applied to the same-transaction quote to derive the effective `min_shares_out` / `max_shares_in`.
fields.name: max_slippage_bps

fields.doc: Never sell an outcome priced below this.
fields.name: min_sell_price_bps

spec.name: PricePolicy

spec.doc: Legacy single-agent configuration. Still the shape returned by the deprecated `get_config` view; live state is [`GlobalConfig`] plus the agent registry.
spec.name: RiskConfig

spec.doc: Hourly ring buffer behind `max_daily`. Kept in instance storage: ~400 bytes that every call loads anyway, so it costs no extra ledger-entry read (a persistent entry would add one per trade). Per-agent windows have the same shape but live in persistent storage.

fields.doc: Always `BUCKETS` long. `amounts[i]` is the usage of hour `head_hour - ((head_idx - i) mod BUCKETS)`.
fields.name: amounts

fields.doc: Hour index (`timestamp / BUCKET_SECONDS`) of the newest bucket.
fields.name: head_hour

spec.name: UsageWindow

spec.doc: `market_valuation` result. Only `cost_basis` is enforced (by `max_net_exposure`); the others are informational.

fields.doc: What the treasury gets back whatever the outcome, from state a price move cannot raise: complete sets `min(yes, no)` plus, as the unclaimed LP, `min(reserve_yes, reserve_no)`. After finality, the settlement value.
fields.name: floor_value

fields.doc: Holdings at the pool's spot price. Manipulable by any trader, so it is never used for enforcement.
fields.name: spot_value

spec.name: Valuation

spec.doc: Collateral still owed to `owner` for shares already burned.
spec.name: WithdrawTicket

cases.doc: Close-date bucket exposure would exceed its cap (#49).
cases.name: BucketCapExceeded

cases.doc: Category exposure would exceed its correlation cap (#49).
cases.name: CategoryCapExceeded

cases.doc: `agent_create_market_and_reveal` was given a malformed resolution envelope or a rule outside the two primary modes (#64).
cases.name: InvalidResolution

cases.doc: A proposed admin handover was not accepted within its `expires_at`.
cases.name: PendingAdminExpired

params.doc: `true` for a tighten-only change applied at proposal time.
params.name: immediate

spec.doc: Net exposure after any treasury money movement in `market_id`.
spec.name: NetExposureUpdated

params.doc: 0 when everything was paid at once.
params.name: ticket_id
